Great inexpensive rooftop bar, for any size group.
May 2026 • Friends
We needed a venue for a table of 18 to celebrate a big birthday in May 2026, and The View Rooftop on Bùi Viện Street turned out to be perfect. We did book a long way in advance to guarantee such a large table. They offered several set‑menu options at a genuinely great price, and even let us choose between the outdoor terrace and the indoor dining area — we chose the terrace.The rooftop space was beautifully decorated in warm Hoi An mustard tones, with lots of red lanterns creating a festive atmosphere. Service was excellent and very attentive throughout the night. The Saigon skyline views were lovely, though a little distant, and you don’t really see or hear Bùi Viện Street from up there. The terrace bar area is large and became very busy later in the evening, likely because the drink prices are extremely affordable and the cocktails are imaginative and fun. Music was great, and although the elevator to the 9th‑floor rooftop is small and gets busy, it wasn’t a problem.Overall, we made a fantastic choice. The View Rooftop is chilled, social, affordable, and very easy to recommend.

We are told that it is normal because the kitchens are 4 floors below and the time to arrive it has cooled!!! Nevertheless we agree to collect our dishes to warm them up; they come back also cold! The 3rd time was the right one but I might as well say that it was so dry and charred that EVERYTHING was inedible. The icing on the cake is that at 11:30 p.m. customers who have been let up without paying the formula, settle down and order a drink. So decided to book the view rooftop bar with my boyfriend and friend for New Year’s Eve after reading it gets great views of the fire works. We paid for 3. NYE Set menu : 1.895.000 VND/pax for 3people
1 Snack combo
3 Food combo
3 Drinks (Fruit Juice / Soft drink / Beer / Glass of Wine / Cocktail )
1 Plate of tropical fruit
This came to $284

On arrival at 10pm we were taken to our table and provided a list of drinks we could have and advised at a charge by the waitress, we advised that we had already paid for the first drink, she then went to get the manager (who did resolve the matter). 

We received our drinks and food which was fine but whilst we were eating we had constant people coming up the stairs to the rooftop standing next to our table whilst we were drinking and having food, my chair was pushed and knocked by a number of people squeezing behind me to get a good look over the balcony at the band. We even had a disagreement with one rude American man, who asked if I could move my chair for him to squeeze In when I declined he became abusive to which my boyfriend had to step in and ask him to apologise and leave, not one staff member bothered to intervene. The crowds kept appearing to get a good spot to watch the fireworks which we had paid to have the privilege to do so but however they were allowed through free and to take up our viewing area, with no respect to the people that had paid quite a substantial amount to get the seats.

We then asked for the manager, who at first was reluctant about doing anything. However he did manage to get most people away apart from 5 people who refused to move, which I still find bizarre they seemed to have the authority rather than the manager. The stairs were eventually closed off but I have to say the view still wasn’t much and I think I could of got a better view from the street at the fireworks. 

After the fireworks the stairs were reopened and we were again hounded by people around the rooftop, the couple behind us were over speaking to us, when a group of girls sat at there reserved table and proceeded to start eating there plate of food they had on the table. After watching in bewilderment and disgust, the man who’s table it was politely told them that it was there table and food, to which he was met by laughter and the girls carried on eating with more friends arriving to join in. 

Around 12.45am we were starting to be ushered out the establishment by the waitresses and advised they closed at 1am, when we were advised it was 2am. We didn’t even get severed our fruit platter when we were out the door. Great food, service (waiter Tuyen), atmosphere and view
Oct 2019 • Family
We thankfully ran across this place on our first night in Saigon. Walking through the Bui Vien District 1, it is at the end of the Main Street across from Celebrity Ink Tattoo. The restaurant/bar is on the roof of a hotel. The name says Bar... but it really is a great place to eat as well. You can get an amazing meal for the same price as a cocktail (average cost 120,000). Beer is around (60,000). The atmosphere is relaxed with a great decor of lanterns and heart lights with a wonderful view of the city. It is above the crowded street below and the music is a good mix of dance and current pop. We stayed in Saigon 6 nights and ate in many different places, but always found our way back to the Rooftop Bar each evening to relax. We could count on the food being great (there is a variety of food from Western to Asian) and our wonderful waiter Tuyen being there to serve us. Tuyen was an amazing waiter and spoke English well and was also very friendly. ❤️
